customMethods.name: getData
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("getData() called")
	
	self.clearData()
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": True, "text": "Getting lots...", "type": "INFO"}
	
	filters = self.view.custom.filters
	
	paramsDict = {}
	if filters['hasQty']:
		paramsDict['hasQty'] = filters['hasQty']
		paramsDict['enabled'] = True
	else:
		paramsDict['startDate'] = filters['startDate']
		paramsDict['endDate'] = filters['endDate']
	
	if filters['itemPath']: paramsDict['itemPath'] = filters['itemPath'] + '%'
	if filters['assetPath']: paramsDict['assetPath'] = filters['assetPath'] + '%'
	if filters['assetTransportName']: paramsDict['assetTransportName'] = filters['assetTransportName']
	if filters['workOrderName']: paramsDict['workOrderName'] = filters['workOrderName']
	
	data = system.kanoa.lot.getLotActivity(paramsDict)
	data = system.dataset.sort(data, 'tStamp', False)
	data = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(data)

	self.view.custom.table.data = data
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": False, "text": "", "type": "INFO"}
	
	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("itemSelected() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	filters = dict(self.view.custom.filters)
	
	if len(payload['selection']) == 0: 
		filters['itemId'] = None
		filters['itemPath'] = None
	else:
		filters['itemId'] = payload['selection'][0]['value']['itemId'] if payload['selection'][0]['value'].has_key('itemId') else None
		filters['itemPath'] = payload['selection'][0]['value']['path'] if payload['selection'][0]['value'].has_key('path') else None
	
	self.view.custom.filters = filters
	
	return
